mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To create an inclusive, supportive community for Ambedkarite Buddhists across Canada, fostering spiritual growth, education, and social justice rooted in the teachings of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and Buddhist philosophy.

points.title: Community Building
points.description: Create safe spaces for Ambedkarite Buddhists to gather, celebrate, and support one another.

points.title: Education & Awareness
points.description: Promote understanding of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's philosophy and Buddhist teachings through events and resources.

points.title: Social Welfare
points.description: Support community members and contribute to social justice initiatives aligned with Ambedkarite principles.

points.title: Accessibility
points.description: Ensure our community is welcoming to newcomers and provides resources for all members.

values.title: Equality & Justice
values.description: We believe in the dignity and equality of all people, following Dr. Ambedkar's vision of a just society.

values.title: Compassion & Empathy
values.description: We practice Buddhist compassion in all our interactions, supporting each other with kindness.

values.title: Education & Growth
values.description: We are committed to continuous learning and personal development for ourselves and our community.

values.title: Transparency & Integrity
values.description: We operate with honesty and openness, building trust through ethical practices.

values.title: Inclusivity & Respect
values.description: We celebrate diversity and respect all cultural backgrounds within our community.

values.title: Service to Community
values.description: We are dedicated to serving our members and contributing positively to society.

history.title: Our Journey
history.description: The Ambedkarite Buddhist Community in Canada was founded to bring together followers of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's vision and Buddhist philosophy. Starting with a small group of dedicated individuals, we have grown into a vibrant community spanning multiple cities across Canada.

milestones.title: Community Established
milestones.description: A group of passionate individuals came together to create a space for Ambedkarite Buddhists in Canada.

milestones.title: First Annual Celebration
milestones.description: Hosted our inaugural Dhamma Chakra Pravartan Din celebration bringing together community members.

milestones.title: Expanded Reach
milestones.description: Grew our community presence across multiple Canadian cities with regional chapters.

milestones.title: Digital Platform Launch
milestones.description: Created online resources and communities to support members regardless of location.

milestones.title: Nonprofit Recognition
milestones.description: Formalized as a nonprofit organization dedicated to community service and social welfare.

team.title: Leadership Team
team.description: Our community is led by dedicated volunteers who share a passion for Ambedkarite Buddhism and community service.
